build_MeshRenderer: build a MeshRenderer with a rasterizer and shader to render a batch of 3D meshes into images
build_MeshRendererWithFragments: build a MeshRendererWithFragments to render meshes and extract depth maps from the returned fragments zbuf
run_MeshRenderer_forward: run the MeshRenderer forward pass on world-space meshes to rasterize and shade them into rendered images
run_MeshRendererWithFragments_forward: run the MeshRendererWithFragments forward pass to get both rendered images and fragments for depth extraction
review_MeshRenderer_to: review the MeshRenderer to method which moves the rasterizer and shader to a specified device
